Name: Caleb Seasonal Portraits
Author: kuikiNana
Description:
[b][center][size=5]Simply Install[/size][/center][/b]

1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32814]shiiteyanyo's Caleb mod[/url] before you download this folder.

  请先下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32814]夏以昼模组[/url]以及[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]高清头像Plus[/url]

2. Download and unzip the folder, drag it to Mods>Portraiture>Portraits

    (Do not change the folder name, You can check the installation path in the "IMAGES" page)

  将压缩包解压并放入Portraits文件夹中，路径是：Mods>Portraiture>Portraits

  可以在IMAGES页面查看安装路径

  如果原来有其他的夏以昼肖像，则直接替换文件。不要更改文件名，否则图片无法被识别

3. That's it, enjoy! <3
    If you don't see portraits in the game, press [ P ], then press [ O ] to fix it!

   进入游戏，在和夏以昼对话时按P切换头像，接着按O锁定。

Downloads.Description: I fixed some issue, please download the latest version. Check your folder, make sure you have a mainfest.json file as well as 8 pictures in the folder.
